sloka: मिथिलाधिपतिर्वीरो जनको नाम धर्मवित् ।क्षत्ऺत्रधर्मे ह्यभिरतो न्यायत: शास्ति मेदिनीम् ॥ २.११८.२७॥
transliteration: mithilādhipatirvīro janako nāma dharmavit ।kṣatऺtradharme hyabhirato nyāyata: śāsti medinīm ॥ 2.118.27॥

translations.english: There is a king in Mithila, Janaka by name. He is heroic and is conversant with righteousness. Engaged in the duties of a kshatriya, he is rules the earth with justice.
